```{r setup, include=FALSE}
## Load packages
# remotes::install_github('ssdqa/squba',
# 												dependencies = 'hard')
library(squba)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

## Unpack & clean up sample data
if(file.exists('squba_example_amia_squba_sampledata.tar.gz') & 
	 !dir.exists('amia_squba_sampledata')){
	untar('squba_example_amia_squba_sampledata.tar.gz',
				exdir = 'amia_squba_sampledata')
}

if(dir.exists('amia_squba_sampledata/masked_amia_squba_sampledata')){
	dir_header <- 'amia_squba_sampledata/masked_amia_squba_sampledata/'
	header_new <- 'amia_squba_sampledata/'
	
	mod_list <- c('ca','cnc_sp','csd','cvd','dr','evp',
								'pes','pf','prc','qvd','scv','ssc','uc')
	
	for(k in mod_list){
		file.rename(paste0(dir_header, k),
								paste0(header_new, k))
	}
	
	unlink(dir_header, recursive = TRUE)
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

```

# Cohort Attrition
## Single Site, Exploratory, Cross-Sectional

```{r}

plt <- ca_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ca/ca_ss_exp_cs_mask.csv'),
								 var_col = 'num_pts' ## try changing this!
								 )

make_interactive_squba(plt[[1]])
plt[[2]]

```

## Multi Site, Exploratory, Cross-Sectional

```{r}

plt <- ca_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ca/ca_ms_exp_cs_mask.csv'),
								 var_col = 'num_pts')

make_interactive_squba(plt[[1]])
plt[[2]]

```

### Large N
```{r}
plt <- ca_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ca/ca_ms_exp_cs_mask.csv'),
								 large_n = T,
								 large_n_sites = c('hospital_e', 'hospital_g')
								 )

make_interactive_squba(plt[[1]])
plt[[2]]
```

## Multi Site, Anomaly Detection, Cross-Sectional

```{r}
plt <- ca_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ca/ca_ms_anom_cs_mask.csv'))

make_interactive_squba(plt)
```

### Large N
```{r}
ca_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ca/ca_ms_anom_cs_mask.csv') %>%
						dplyr::filter(step_number != 1),
					large_n = T)
```

# Sensitivity to Selection Criteria
## Single Site, Exploratory, Cross-Sectional

```{r, fig.width=8}

plt <- ssc_output(
	process_output=list(read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ssc/ssc_ss_exp_cs_summary_values_mask.csv'),
											read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ssc/ssc_ss_exp_cs_cohort_overlap_mask.csv')),
									alt_cohort_filter = c('Hydroxyurea Exposure', 'SS/SB0 Diagnosis')
	)

plt[[1]]
plt[[2]]

```

## Single Site, Anomaly Detection, Cross-Sectional

```{r, fig.height=10}

plt <- ssc_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ssc/ssc_ss_anom_cs_mask.csv'),
									alt_cohort_filter = c('Hydroxyurea Exposure', 'SS/SB0 Diagnosis'))

plt

```

## Multi Site, Exploratory, Cross-Sectional

```{r}

plt <- ssc_output(process_output =
										read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/ssc/ssc_ms_exp_cs_summary_values_mask.csv'),
									alt_cohort_filter = c('Hydroxyurea Exposure', 'SS/SB0 Diagnosis'))

plt1_edit <- plt[[1]] +
	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

plt2_edit <- plt[[2]] +
	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

make_interactive_squba(plt1_edit)
make_interactive_squba(plt2_edit)

```

# Clinical Events & Specialties
## Single Site, Exploratory, Cross-Sectional
```{r}
cnc_sp_output(cnc_sp_process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/cnc_sp_ss_exp_cs_mask.csv'),
							cnc_sp_process_names = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/specialty_names_labeled.csv'))
```

## Multi-Site, Exploratory, Cross-Sectional
```{r}
plt <- cnc_sp_output(cnc_sp_process_output = 
										 	read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/cnc_sp_ms_exp_cs_mask.csv'),
										 cnc_sp_process_names = 
										 	read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/specialty_names_labeled.csv'))

make_interactive_squba(plt)

```

### Large N
```{r}
plt <- cnc_sp_output(cnc_sp_process_output = 
										 	read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/cnc_sp_ms_exp_cs_mask.csv'),
										 cnc_sp_process_names = 
										 	read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/specialty_names_labeled.csv'),
										 large_n = T)

make_interactive_squba(plt)

```

## Multi-Site, Anomaly Detection, Longitudinal (Large N)
```{r}
plt <- cnc_sp_output(cnc_sp_process_output = 
										 	read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/cnc_sp_ms_anom_la_mask.csv') %>%
										 	mutate(time_start = as.Date(time_start, '%m/%d/%y')) %>%
										 	filter(cluster == 'hydroxyurea'),
										 cnc_sp_process_names = 
										 	read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/cnc_sp/specialty_names_labeled.csv'),
										 specialty_filter = 'Hematology/Oncology',
										 large_n = T)

make_interactive_squba(plt)

```

# Concept Set Distribution (**MAYBE**)
## Single Site, Anomaly Detection, Cross-Sectional
```{r, fig.width=8}

plt <- csd_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/csd/csd_ss_anom_cs_mask.csv'),
									filter_variable = 'SCD Diagnosis',
									vocab_tbl = read_csv('code_sets/rx_hydroxyurea.csv') %>% 
									 	select(-cluster) %>% 
									 	union(read_csv('code_sets/dx_scd.csv', col_types = 'iccc')))

make_interactive_squba(plt)

```

# Duplicate Records

```{r}
								 output_col = 'duplicate_pt_prop')

make_interactive_squba(plt_edit)

```

```{r}

plt <- dr_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/dr/dr_ss_anom_la_mask.csv'),
								 output_col = 'duplicate_pt_prop',
								 filter_definition = 'duplicate procedures per visit & date')

make_interactive_squba(plt)

```


## Multi-Site, Exploratory, Cross-Sectional
```{r, fig.width=9}

plt <- evp_output(process_output = read_csv('amia_squba_sampledata/evp/evp_ms_exp_cs_mask.csv') %>%
										mutate(prop_pt_variable = round(prop_pt_variable, 2)),

	theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
				text = element_text(size = 9))

make_interactive_squba(plt_edit)

```

```{r, fig.width=9}
									output_level = 'patient',

plt[[3]]

```
